mata-bala-sundari-mandir.about: Mullana's best-known temple, to the Devi as Bala Sundari. The mandir posts its aarti times and Navratri programme on Instagram at @mata.bala.sunderi.mandir.
mata-bala-sundari-mandir.more: Its history isn't written down anywhere we could find. If you know the story of the mandir, tap Report a mistake below and tell us. We'll add it with your name.

maharishi-markandeshwar-university-mmdu.about: Maharishi Markandeshwar (Deemed to be University), founded in 1993 as an engineering college. Medicine, dentistry, nursing, pharmacy, engineering, management, law and agriculture on one campus.

mmimsr-hospital.about: MM Institute of Medical Sciences and Research, the university's teaching hospital. For an ambulance, call 108 or 112.

mmimsr-blood-bank.about: The blood bank at the MMIMSR hospital on the MMDU campus.

chc-mullana-government-health-centre.about: The government Community Health Centre for Mullana and the villages around it.

new-grain-market-anaj-mandi.about: Mullana's grain market. Wheat from April, then mustard, maize and sunflower in their seasons.

shiva-statue.about: A large statue of Shiva, a Mullana landmark.

mmdu-academic-block.about: One of the academic blocks on the MMDU campus.
